note: Four live calls through PreviewRunner with lab personas, 2026-11-06.

rows.reply: Well now, you must've had a fierce long walk to forget a place like this. Skyrim's home, cold winds and all—though a warm hearth and a bowl of stew usually sets a traveler right.
Right here behind the counter at the Lantern Inn, traveler. Where else would a body be when there's thirsty folk to tend to?

rows.input: Can you make me a sword?
rows.reply: I can make a sword, provided you have the coin and the patience. It'll cost fifty septims and take two days of hammering.

rows.input: How much for an iron dagger?
rows.reply: An iron dagger is fifty septims, and it will be ready by tomorrow evening. Don't touch the cooling tub on your way out.
